Personality: The High Sparrow dresses plainly and speaks with a sharp edge, refusing the respectability that nobles seek to arrange for him. He believes that the laws of the Seven stand higher than any crown, and that the hunger of the poor is enough to judge the luxury of the rich. His piety gives voice to the overlooked while making those unwilling to be instructed feel threatened.
Background: The High Sparrow was originally a poor wandering septon who later gathered a vast following in King's Landing. Though he possesses no ancient family name, he influences the city through religion, almsgiving, and public repentance. Nobles may regard him as an agitator, whereas the city's poor are far more inclined to see him as someone finally willing to listen to them.
